utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have all the tools we need for that repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got my trusty old toolbox ready to go, just let me grab a few more wrenches from the shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did you double-check the list? I'd hate to get halfway there and realize we're missing something crucial.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Uli, I heard about the repair drive—how's the planning going?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's coming along slowly. We're still gathering parts for the jobs folks need done.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's good to hear. If you need help rounding up tools or coordinating pickup times, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the repair drive? What's that about again? I'm in a rush.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard it's the community fixing up stuff together—tools, bikes, that sort of thing. You might want to check the notice board down the street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, got it—thanks for the quick rundown. I'll swing by the board later if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools ready. Driveway repair starts at 10, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, 10 o'clock sharp! I'll bring the coffee and donuts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll handle the mixing. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Dane, you mentioned the repair drive earlier—what's that about?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh yeah, it’s just a neighborhood thing—we’re pooling tools and skills to fix up a few broken fences and stuff this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. What kind of tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Cleo, what exactly is the repair drive for? Just want to make sure I understand before we dive into it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to gather tools and materials for fixing up the shared spaces—like the playground and the community garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so we’re focusing on tools for the playground and garden shed. Do we have a list of what’s needed yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Quinn! I heard about the repair drive — remind me, what day are folks meeting at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! It's this Saturday at 10 a.m. — I've been telling everyone, don't miss it!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, 10 a.m. — got it! I'll write it down before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa! I'm so glad you're here. I was thinking we could organize a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's a wonderful idea, Mara! I've been wanting to get the neighbors together for a community activity, and fixing things up sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! I was thinking we could start at 9 AM in the community garden. Should we make a flyer to post around?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where exactly is this repair drive taking place?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's at the community center parking lot, from nine to three this Saturday. You planning on bringing something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I have an old lamp that needs rewiring. Is there a limit on what they'll fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I heard you're organizing that neighborhood repair drive — need any help grabbing supplies while I'm out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, that would be great! I'm planning to pick up some lumber and paint from the hardware store. Could you grab a few cans of white paint?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can grab the white paint. How many cans do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're actually going through with that? Are you sure it'll work?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Well, I mean, it's worth a shot, right? If it gets the old generator running again, why not?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I heard you're organizing a repair drive — I've got some tools I can lend out, just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I'm putting together a list of needed tools — could you let me know exactly what you have so I can match it up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I've got a cordless drill, a socket set, and a small soldering iron. Want me to bring them by?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Pia, what's the plan for this repair drive? I like to have a clear schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we're aiming for Saturday morning, starting at 9 AM sharp, but I need to confirm we have enough tools and spare parts before anyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 AM, got it. I can be there to help organize the tools — let me know if you need me to bring anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I heard there's a repair drive happening this weekend. You know anything about that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are you sure you're not mixing it up with that yard sale down the street?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, I'm pretty sure it's a repair drive. Mrs. Henderson mentioned it when I saw her at the grocery store.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Cleo, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's just something I'm organizing for the neighborhood—collecting extra tools and materials folks can share for fixing things up around here.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tools? Like hammers and wrenches? I think I've got an old drill somewhere in the garage I could dig up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Leo! So glad I ran into you—I was just finalizing the schedule for the neighborhood repair drive, and I wanted to see if you'd be free to lend a hand this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me. What time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great! We're starting at 9 AM sharp. I'll put you down for the morning shift. Thanks, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Mara, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help setting up or fixing things?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Sam! Could you help me sort through the donated tools on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Mara. I'll bring my toolbox and we can get everything sorted before the rush starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I heard a little about it. What kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're looking for volunteers to help fix fences, paint benches, and plant flowers in the park. You'd be perfect for any of those!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive! Do you know where we're supposed to meet up for that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure, I've only heard bits and pieces. Did someone mention a time or place?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I heard the community center is usually the spot for these drives, but let's confirm with someone who might know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Vik! That repair drive thing... I was supposed to bring my old toaster, wasn't I? Did I miss it already?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Oren! No, you didn't miss it—it's still happening this Saturday at the community center. I keep telling everyone to bring their broken stuff!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, right, Saturday. I'll write it down this time... probably.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—need any help rounding up some folks from the other side of the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Jules! Wait, a repair drive? Right, right, I did mention that, didn't I? Honest, I keep getting sidetracked... yeah, any help you could give would be awesome.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll start spreading the word at the community center—those folks are always eager to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, did you hear about that repair drive they're organizing down on Maple Street? I heard they're fixing up old bikes and appliances for folks who can't afford it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about that! I've got a bunch of spare wrenches and screwdrivers I could lend out. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh that's great, Gus! They could really use your help. I think they're meeting at the community center Saturday morning if you want to drop by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, you mentioned a repair drive — is it for the community computer system or something else?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's for the old playground equipment down the street. Did you see the broken swing set last week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I did see it—the chains were frayed pretty badly. Are you planning to fix it yourself or is there a scheduled repair day?
